title: rpms-ops release RPC facts, v2 (<tag>-rpcs.json)
description: Every RPC a release's build registers (#8994), one record per RPC in byte order of its name, projected from the release's raw inventory files by bin/release_rpcs_json.rb (rpms-ops#732). Facts only: each value is read from broker_8994.txt, rpc_signatures.txt, rpc_reach.txt or packages_9_4.txt; codes are kept as stored, never decoded. The raw files stay canonical; this file is a view of them, and its header names their sha256s. v2 (rpms-ops#877) is v1 with #8994's text and the fields v1 left out added (an RPC's word_wrap, version, description and returns; a parameter's sequence, max_length and description); every v1 field is unchanged. Text is kept as stored, byte for byte: each byte is read as the Latin-1 character of the same value, so a byte 0x80-0xFF is the escape \u0080-\u00ff in this ASCII-only file, and mapping each code point back to the byte of that value gives the stored bytes.

engine.description: INVENTORY-PROVENANCE.json engine; agrees with the tag suffix.

inputs.description: Each file read, by its name after the <tag>- prefix (the release asset is <tag>-<key>), and its sha256: the values <tag>-INVENTORY.sha256 seals.

code.description: A #8994 field as stored (null when empty).

text.description: A word-processing field's lines as stored, in order, each one rpc_signatures.txt line's text (ZRPCCAT turns a tab, CR or LF inside a line into a space); empty when the field has no lines.

name.description: #8994 NAME (.01), the name sent over the broker.

tag.description: #8994 TAG (.02); null when empty (the routine's first line).

formals.description: The formal list on the entry point's own line (rpc_signatures.txt), in order; empty when it has none or the entry point is absent.

availability.description: #8994 AVAILABILITY (.05) as stored: P, S, A or R.

inactive.description: #8994 INACTIVE (.06) as stored: 0-3, null when empty.

word_wrap.description: #8994 WORD WRAP ON (.08) as stored: 1 or 0, null when empty.

version.description: #8994 VERSION (.09) as stored, null when empty.

returns.description: #8994 RETURN PARAMETER DESCRIPTION (3), the RET lines.

parameters.description: The arguments in the order rpc_signatures.txt lists them (#8994.02's IEN order, not SEQUENCE NUMBER order). #8994 INPUT PARAMETERs (source 8994) when the RPC defines any; otherwise the entry point's formals after the first, which is the reply variable every broker passes (source formals, with type, required, sequence and max_length null and description empty).

package.description: The #9.4 package whose PREFIX is the longest prefix of the routine (first in packages_9_4.txt among equals); null when none is, or the RPC names no routine.

contexts.description: The options (#19) whose RPC multiple lists it, usable or not.

exemptions.description: The brokers that run it in any context.

type.description: #8994.02 PARAMETER TYPE as stored (1-4); null for source formals.

required.description: #8994.02 REQUIRED is 1; null for source formals.

sequence.description: #8994.02 SEQUENCE NUMBER (.05) as stored, a number as text (it may be fractional, empty or repeated within an RPC); null when empty and for source formals.

max_length.description: #8994.02 MAXIMUM DATA LENGTH (.03) as stored, a number as text; null when empty and for source formals.

description.description: #8994.02 DESCRIPTION (1), the parameter's PDESC lines; empty for source formals.
